_meta.note: 一個故事一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Rymek Thief#001.src: Hey there friend! Looking teh barter fer some weapons or trinkets?
Rymek Thief#001.dst: よう、相棒！武器や小物と交換していかねえか？
Rymek Thief#001.speaker: Shopkeeper

Rymek Thief#002.src: Scum! That guy jus' stole a necklace! Catch 'im and jus' take this as payment!!
Rymek Thief#002.dst: くそったれ！あいつ今ネックレスを盗みやがった！捕まえてくれ、礼にこいつを持ってけ！！
Rymek Thief#002.speaker: Shopkeeper

Rymek Thief#003.src: Looks like you were followed, boy.
Rymek Thief#003.dst: どうやら、お前は尾行されていたようだ、坊や。
Rymek Thief#003.speaker: Bandit Leader

Rymek Thief#004.src: Well, what do we do now, we're caught by the famous {p} Guard.
Rymek Thief#004.dst: さて、これからどうする？　あの有名な{p}の衛兵に捕まってしまった。
Rymek Thief#004.speaker: Bandit Leader

Rymek Thief#005.src: Or maybe.. You're looking fer somefin else..
Rymek Thief#005.dst: それとも……もしかして、お前は別の何かを探しているのか……
Rymek Thief#005.speaker: Bandit Leader

Rymek Thief#006.dst: JEFFERY 、今はよせ。行儀よくしろ。
Rymek Thief#006.speaker: Bandit Leader

Rymek Thief#008.src: Listen, we ain' all bad. Sure we like to nick stuff but thats how its always been.
Rymek Thief#008.dst: なあ、俺たちみんなが悪いわけじゃないんだ。確かに物を盗むのは好きだけど、昔からずっとそうだったんだ。
Rymek Thief#008.speaker: Bandit Leader

Rymek Thief#009.src: Our daddies daddies escaped your stupid corruption war to the desert, it ain' got anyfin to do with us.
Rymek Thief#009.dst: 俺たちの親父たちは、あんたらの馬鹿げた腐敗戦争から逃れて砂漠へ逃げたんだ。俺たちとは何の関係もないよ。
Rymek Thief#009.speaker: Bandit Leader

Rymek Thief#010.src: So, let's just let this go and you can go back to yer war.
Rymek Thief#010.dst: じゃあ、この件は水に流して、お前はまた自分の戦争に戻ればいいさ。
Rymek Thief#010.speaker: Bandit Leader

Rymek Thief#011.src: We'll let yer go without a fight, and you keep yer mouth shut.
Rymek Thief#011.dst: 抵抗しなければ、お前を放してやる。その代わり、口は堅く閉じておけ。
Rymek Thief#011.speaker: Bandit Leader

Rymek Thief#012.dst: お前ら、こいつを送り出せ。
Rymek Thief#012.speaker: Bandit Leader

Rymek Thief#013.src: It appears that the bandits took some of your money while you were unconscious
Rymek Thief#013.dst: {c1}意識を失っている間に、山賊たちがお金の一部を持ち去ったようだ{/}
Rymek Thief#013.note: {c1}It appears that the bandits took some of your money while you were unconscious{/}
